title: Two-length builders
notes: Keep one adult at each of the three tables and let partners alternate building and recording. On return, K-1 can grow a gap-free run (P4), contrast even-only rods (P5), or choose a pair (P6). Grades 2-3 can build finite coverage certificates and compare 4/7 with 2/4 (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can pursue rod exchanges, the last-gap prediction or the coprime coverage argument (P5-8). Keep a few successful adjacent targets visible instead of reconstructing a large table; the formulas are further explanations, not an introductory requirement.
